description: This file provides functions for interacting with a backend API, including methods for making GET and POST requests, especially related to 'work items'. It contains API call utilities, data fetching functions, and helper functions for URL handling.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the backend and returns parsed JSON or throws an error with message.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, handles JSON parsing and errors.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches work items from backend, optionally filtered by projectId.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item with specified properties, following backend API specification.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs full URL for the given API path.

ctags.name: createWorkItem
ctags.pattern: /^export async function createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priori/
ctags.signature: ({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
